ios.desc:
This app was created to be a simple way to track weight training workouts. The vision of this app is to have a way to store workouts data without the logging process getting in the way.

KEY FEATURES
- Visualize the weight of your exercises in a clear way.
- Store workout daily data.
- Log number of sets, exercises, weight

show_hn.title: Show HN: The simplest iOS app to log your workout sessions

quotes.text:
Hey everyone!

The backstory is that I found myself using the native iOS "Notes" app to log my sets and it was a pain, I searched for other apps and they were all too complex for what I need.

I need to just log the bare minimum for an exercise and have access to the history of sets that I've done to get an idea on how much weight to put on the machine next time. And that's exactly the problem that this app solves.

I have a few friends and a few users (~30) using the iOS app already which is exciting. Here's the link if anyone is interested, the app is 100% free and contains no ads:

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/gymlog-app/id6736846878?platform=iphone

quotes.text:
Hey everyone on HN,

I’m Carlos and I built this app called GymLog. I looked at other workout logging apps in the market but found that many of them are too complex for what I need. The app is completely free, it has no ads and no in-app purchases.

My guess is that this a niche app as only people who lift seriously will log their workouts. I’ve been using it for a few months it’s been a better experience, so I thought maybe a few others would enjoy using this app.

This is an example of what my notes would look like in the past:

https://imgur.com/a/qPZUs8Q

This is how things look now:

https://imgur.com/a/P0iyhax

Here's the link to the App Store if anyone is interested:
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/gymlog-app/id6736846878
